source_title: Enhancement and contextual modulation of visuospatial processing by thalamocollicular projections from ventral lateral geniculate nucleus
node_relevance_reason: Characterises vLGN VGAT+ GABAergic neurons projecting to superior colliculus, with vLGN predominantly GABAergic and also projecting to PAG and nucleus reuniens.
summary: vLGN GABAergic neurons send long-range inhibitory projections to SC (and PAG, Re) and exert surround suppression on SC visuospatial processing.
quotes: Unlike the dLGN, the vLGN is predominantly populated by GABAergic neurons [7][8][9] and does not project to the visual cortex 7 .

Through GABAergic thalamocollicular projections, vLGN specifically exerts prominent surround suppression of visuospatial processing in SC, leading to a fine tuning of SC preferences to higher spatial frequencies and smaller objects in a context-dependent manner.

source_title: A High‐Resolution Transcriptomic Atlas of Cell Types in the Ventral Visual Thalamus
node_relevance_reason: snRNA-seq atlas of mouse vLGN with 20 neuron types, most GABAergic including projection neurons, 13 retinorecipient.
summary: Single-nucleus atlas identifies 20 neuronal types in vLGN, mostly GABAergic (including projection neurons) plus at least two excitatory types; at least 13 clusters are retinorecipient.
quotes: While principal retinorecipient neurons in dLGN are excitatory thalamocortical relay cells (TRCs), most neurons in vLGN are GABAergic, including GABAergic projection neurons.
we discovered at least 13 retinorecipient neuron clusters in vLGN (which included the two clusters of excitatory cells) that are directly connected to the retina.

source_title: Diverse GABAergic neurons organize into subtype-specific sublaminae in the ventral lateral geniculate nucleus
section: | Do laminated retinorecipient circuits organize visual pathways through the vLGN?
node_relevance_reason: Names GABAergic subtype markers (Pvalb, Penk, Spp1, Ecel1, Lypd1) and projection targets (SC, pretectum, habenula, ZI) of vLGN neurons.
summary: Identifies transcriptomically distinct vLGN GABAergic subtypes (Pvalb, Penk, Spp1, Ecel1, Lypd1) in four sublaminae of vLGNe, several retinorecipient; vLGN neurons project to over a dozen subcortical targets.
quotes: Using anterograde trans-synaptic tracing, we identified Ecel1 + , Pvalb + , Spp1 + , and Penk + cells as retinorecipient, together representing at least three sublaminae of vLGNe.

neurons in vLGN project to a diverse set of over a dozen downstream subcortical regions including the SC, the nucleus of the optic tract and other pretectal nuclei (Cadusseau & Roger, 1991;Swanson, Cowan, & Jones, 1974;Trejo & Cicerone, 1984), the suprachiasmatic nucleus (at least in hamsters) (Harrington, 1997), the habenula (Huang et al., 2019;Oh et al., 2014), and zona incerta (Ribak & Peters, 1975)

source_title: Divergent outputs of the ventral lateral geniculate nucleus mediate visually evoked defensive behaviors
section: Divergent vLGN outputs exert opposite influences on defensive behaviors
node_relevance_reason: Shows Gad2+/Vgat+ vLGN GABA neurons project to SC and nucleus reuniens; vLGN-Re neurons are 100% Vgat+.
summary: vLGN GABA neurons project to SC and Re as distinct output pathways with opposite influences on defensive behaviour; ~65% of SC-projecting vLGN cells are Gad2+.
quotes: Notably, retrograde tracing revealed that all labeled vLGN→Re neurons were in fact GABAergic (100% Vgat+ neurons), with approximately half of all neurons specifically labeled by Gad2 (Figure S3).
We found that approximately two-thirds (~65%) of vLGN cells that project to the SC were Gad2+ cells.

source_title: Pattern of Driver-Like Input onto Neurons of the Mouse Ventral Lateral Geniculate Nucleus
node_relevance_reason: States virtually all vLGN neurons, including projection neurons, are GABAergic, with Pvalb/Penk neurons in vLGNe and calbindin in vLGNi.
summary: Virtually all vLGN neurons are GABAergic with transcriptionally distinct, laminated types; vLGNe neurons receive driver-like retinal and layer V cortical input.
quotes: While glutamatergic thalamocortical relay neurons are the predominant neuronal cell type in most thalamic nuclei including dLGN, virtually all neurons in vLGN are GABAergic, including their projection neurons
parvalbumin-and proenkephalin-expressing neurons residing exclusively in vLGNe and calbindin-expressing neurons residing in vLGNi

source_title: Retinal Input Is Required for the Maintenance of Neuronal Laminae in the Ventrolateral Geniculate Nucleus
node_relevance_reason: Ecel1+/Lypd1+ and Penk+ GABAergic vLGN subtypes proposed to be projection neurons, not interneurons.
summary: Ecel1+/Lypd1+ and Penk+ vLGN GABAergic neurons form subtype-specific laminae specified at or before birth; they do not depend on retinal input for migration and may be projection neurons.
quotes: suggesting to us that Ecel1 + and Penk + cells in vLGN are not interneurons and instead may represent projection neurons.

Indeed, our results showed that all cells that express Lypd1 mRNA also generate Ecel1 mRNA in vLGNe and vLGNi (Fig. 2B-B"), indicating that these markers correspond to the same GABAergic neuronal subtype.

source_title: A Role for Thalamic Projection GABAergic Neurons in Circadian Responses to Light
node_relevance_reason: Targets Sox14+ GABAergic projection neurons of the IGL and LGv (vLGN) which receive retinal input.
summary: Thalamic GABAergic projection neurons of IGL and LGv (ventral LGN) receive retinal input from diverse RGC classes but not M1 ipRGCs and contribute to circadian entrainment and vigilance-state changes.
quotes: Our results show that thalamic GABAergic neurons of the IGL and LGv receive retinal input from diverse classes of retinal ganglion cells (RGCs) but not from the M1 intrinsically photosensitive retinal ganglion cell (ipRGC) type.

source_title: Not a one-trick pony: Diverse connectivity and functions of the rodent lateral geniculate complex
node_relevance_reason: Review: vLGN of nocturnal rodents is predominantly GABAergic, with vLGNe/vLGNi laminae and few glutamatergic neurons.
summary: vLGN has a vastly higher population of GABAergic neurons than dLGN and few glutamatergic neurons; vLGNe is retinorecipient, vLGNi is not.
quotes: Thus, in contrast to dLGN where glutamatergic neurons are the major cell type, vLGN contains a vastly higher population of GABAergic neurons
Moreover, the vLGN lacks stereotypic TC relay cells, and has only a limited number of vesicular glutamate transporter-expressing glutamatergic neurons

source_title: An autoradiographic study of the projections from the lateral geniculate body of the rat.
node_relevance_reason: Classic autoradiographic tracing of rat vLGN efferents to SC, pretectum, zona incerta and pons.
summary: Rat vLGN projects to ipsilateral SC (medial stratum opticum), bilateral pretectal areas, zona incerta and pons; GABA identity not addressed.
quotes: One dorsomedial projection coursed caudally from the vLGN through the brachium of the superior colliculus to terminate in the ipsilateral superior colliculus (Fig. 5A, B and C).

Both have ipsilateral projections to the superior colliculus, the zona incerta and the pons; bilateral projections to the pretectal area, lateral terminal nuclei of the accessory optic tract and the suprachiasmatic nuclei of the hypothalamus; and a contralateral projection to the vLGN.

source_title: Sonic hedgehog-dependent recruitment of GABAergic interneurons into the developing visual thalamus
section: Sonic Hedgehog (SHH), but not retinal activity, is critical for interneuron recruitment into visual thalamus
node_relevance_reason: Notes most Gad1+ vLGN cells are principal projection cells rather than local interneurons.
summary: Most Gad1+ cells in vLGN are principal projection cells, and markers distinguishing vLGN interneurons from GABAergic projection neurons are lacking.
quotes: since most Gad1 + cells in vLGN are principal projection cells and not local interneurons.

Unfortunately, we currently lack transcriptional or neurochemical markers to specifically label interneurons in vLGN (versus GABAergic projection neurons) making this challenging to address at this time.

source_title: A visual circuit related to the parabrachial nucleus for the antipruritic effects of bright light treatment.
node_relevance_reason: RGCs innervate GABAergic vLGN/IGL neurons that project to the lateral parabrachial nucleus.
summary: GABAergic neurons in vLGN/IGL project to and inhibit CaMKIIa+ neurons in the lateral parabrachial nucleus, mediating antipruritic effects of light.
quotes: Specifically, a subset of retinal ganglion cells (RGCs) innervates GABAergic neurons in the ventral lateral geniculate nucleus and intergeniculate leaflet (vLGN/IGL), which subsequently inhibit CaMKIIα+ neurons in the LPBN.

source_title: Feature Detection by Retinal Ganglion Cells.
section: Downstream pathways and behavioral significance of retinal contrast detection.
node_relevance_reason: Review noting sONa RGC input to vLGN/IGL GABAergic neurons projecting to lateral habenula and CaMKIIa neurons projecting to reuniens.
summary: sONa RGCs innervate GABAergic vLGN/IGL neurons projecting to the lateral habenula (antidepressant effect of light) and CaMKIIa neurons projecting to nucleus reuniens.
quotes: First, sONα RGCs innervate GABAergic neurons in the vLGN and IGL that project to the lateral habenula (LHb) and mediate antidepressant effects of light (Huang et al. 2019).

source_title: Retinal inputs signal astrocytes to recruit interneurons into visual thalamus
node_relevance_reason: Describes GABAergic cells in vLGN as heterogeneous, with Gad67-GFP labelling only a fraction.
summary: A higher fraction of vLGN/IGL cells are GABAergic than in dLGN and appear heterogeneous; Gad67-GFP interneurons are only a fraction of vLGN GABAergic neurons; Asic4 marks a significant fraction.
quotes: In contrast to the dLGN (and neocortex), a significantly higher fraction of cells in the vLGN and IGL are GABAergic
A large number of GFP + interneurons are also present in the vLGN of these mice; however, in this region these represent only a fraction of the total GABAergic neurons

summary: GABAergic SC neurons ventral to SGS project to vLGN; says little about vLGN neurons themselves.
quotes: GABAergic projections from the SC innervate the vLGN, PT, and PBG but not the dLGN.

section: Glutamatergic and GABAergic organization of the brain.
